),

order_lines_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.b2b_order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS order_lines_count,
    SUM(r.quantity) AS order_lines_quantity,
    SUM(r.net_price_amount) AS order_lines_net_price_amount
  FROM order_lines_rows AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.b2b_order_id
),

invoices_rows AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_b2b_north_america__invoices
),

invoices_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.b2b_order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS invoices_count,
    SUM(r.invoiced_total_amount) AS invoices_invoiced_total_amount
  FROM invoices_rows AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.b2b_order_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    h.b2b_order_id,
    h.wholesale_desk_code,
    h.region_code,
    h.account_id,
    h.placed_at_utc,
    h.currency_code,
    h.total_amount,
    h.status,
    h.po_reference,
    h.placed_date_local,
    h.source_loaded_at,
    COALESCE(c1.order_lines_count, 0)::INT AS order_lines_count,
    COALESCE(c1.order_lines_quantity, 0)::INT AS order_lines_quantity,
    COALESCE(c1.order_lines_net_price_amount, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS order_lines_net_price_amount,
    COALESCE(c2.invoices_count, 0)::INT AS invoices_count,
    COALESCE(c2.invoices_invoiced_total_amount, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS invoices_invoiced_total_amount
  FROM header AS h
  LEFT JOIN order_lines_totals AS c1
    ON h.b2b_order_id = c1.b2b_order_id
  LEFT JOIN invoices_totals AS c2
    ON h.b2b_order_id = c2.b2b_order_id
)

statements.name: int_le_es__ar_ageing
statements.sql:
WITH invoices_in AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_le_es__ar_invoices
),

open_invoices AS (
  SELECT
    v.ar_invoice_id,
    v.customer_ref,
    v.legal_entity_code,
    v.currency_code,
    v.invoiced_total_amount,
    v.due_date,
    DATEDIFF('day', v.due_date, '2026-03-31'::DATE)::INT AS days_overdue
  FROM invoices_in AS v
  WHERE
    v.status <> 'PAID'
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    i.ar_invoice_id,
    i.customer_ref,
    i.legal_entity_code,
    i.currency_code,
    i.invoiced_total_amount,
    i.due_date,
    i.days_overdue,
    CASE
      WHEN i.days_overdue <= 0 THEN 'current'
      WHEN i.days_overdue <= 30 THEN '1_30'
      WHEN i.days_overdue <= 60 THEN '31_60'
      WHEN i.days_overdue <= 90 THEN '61_90'
      ELSE 'over_90'
    END::VARCHAR AS ageing_bucket,
    SUM(i.invoiced_total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.customer_ref)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS counterparty_open_amount
  FROM open_invoices AS i
)

SELECT *
FROM final

  FROM order_items_rows AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.partner_order_id

  SELECT
    r.partner_order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS fees_count,
    SUM(r.fee_amount) AS fees_fee_amount
  FROM fees_rows AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.partner_order_id

  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_mkt_crafts_ae__returns

returns_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.partner_order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS returns_count,
    SUM(r.quantity) AS returns_quantity
  FROM returns_rows AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.partner_order_id
),

  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_mkt_crafts_ae__shipments
),

shipments_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.partner_order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS shipments_count
  FROM shipments_rows AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.partner_order_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    h.partner_order_id,
    h.marketplace_code,
    h.region_code,
    h.buyer_ref,
    h.placed_at_utc,
    h.currency_code,
    h.total_amount,
    h.status,
    h.ship_country,
    h.placed_date_local,
    h.source_loaded_at,
    COALESCE(c1.order_items_count, 0)::INT AS order_items_count,
    COALESCE(c1.order_items_quantity, 0)::INT AS order_items_quantity,
    COALESCE(c1.order_items_item_price_amount, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS order_items_item_price_amount,
    COALESCE(c1.order_items_fees_count, 0)::INT AS order_items_fees_count,
    COALESCE(c2.fees_count, 0)::INT AS fees_count,
    COALESCE(c2.fees_fee_amount, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS fees_fee_amount,
    COALESCE(c3.returns_count, 0)::INT AS returns_count,
    COALESCE(c3.returns_quantity, 0)::INT AS returns_quantity,
    COALESCE(c4.shipments_count, 0)::INT AS shipments_count
  FROM header AS h
  LEFT JOIN order_items_totals AS c1
    ON h.partner_order_id = c1.partner_order_id
  LEFT JOIN fees_totals AS c2
    ON h.partner_order_id = c2.partner_order_id
  LEFT JOIN returns_totals AS c3
    ON h.partner_order_id = c3.partner_order_id
  LEFT JOIN shipments_totals AS c4
    ON h.partner_order_id = c4.partner_order_id
)

FROM final

statements.name: int_web_eu_west__sessions
statements.sql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_eu_west__events
),

human_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.anonymous_id,
    e.customer_id,
    e.storefront_code,
    e.event_type,
    e.event_at_utc,
    e.page_path,
    e.referrer_host,
    e.client_timezone
  FROM events AS e
  WHERE
    e.event_at_utc >= DATEADD('hour', -24, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-01 00:00:00'))
    AND e.event_at_utc < DATEADD('hour', 24, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-02 00:00:00'))
    AND NOT e.is_bot
    AND e.anonymous_id IS NOT NULL
),

gaps AS (
  SELECT
    h.event_id,
    h.anonymous_id,
    h.customer_id,
    h.storefront_code,
    h.event_type,
    h.event_at_utc,
    h.page_path,
    h.referrer_host,
    h.client_timezone,
    IFF(DATEDIFF(
      'minute',
      LAG(h.event_at_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY h.anonymous_id ORDER BY h.event_at_utc, h.event_id),
      h.event_at_utc
    ) <= 30, 0, 1) AS is_session_start
  FROM human_events AS h
),

numbered AS (
  SELECT
    g.anonymous_id,
    g.customer_id,
    g.storefront_code,
    g.event_type,
    g.event_at_utc,
    g.page_path,
    g.referrer_host,
    g.client_timezone,
    SUM(g.is_session_start) OVER (
      PARTITION BY g.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY g.event_at_utc, g.event_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS session_number
  FROM gaps AS g
),

grouped AS (
  SELECT
    n.anonymous_id,
    MAX(n.customer_id) AS customer_id,
    MIN_BY(n.storefront_code, n.event_at_utc) AS storefront_code,
    MIN(n.event_at_utc) AS session_start_utc,
    MAX(n.event_at_utc) AS session_end_utc,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT_IF(n.event_type = 'page_view') AS page_view_count,
    MIN_BY(n.page_path, n.event_at_utc) AS landing_page_path,
    MIN_BY(n.referrer_host, n.event_at_utc) AS referrer_host,
    MIN_BY(n.client_timezone, n.event_at_utc) AS client_timezone,
    BOOLOR_AGG(n.event_type = 'add_to_cart') AS has_add_to_cart,
    BOOLOR_AGG(n.event_type = 'checkout_complete') AS has_order
  FROM numbered AS n
  GROUP BY
    n.anonymous_id,
    n.session_number
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      s.anonymous_id || ':' || TO_CHAR(s.session_start_utc, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
    )::VARCHAR AS session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    s.storefront_code::VARCHAR AS storefront_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('day', s.session_start_utc)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS session_day,
    s.session_start_utc::DATE AS session_date,
    s.session_start_utc,
    s.session_end_utc,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      'UTC',
      COALESCE(s.client_timezone, 'UTC'),
      s.session_start_utc
    )::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS session_start_visitor_local,
    DATEDIFF('second', s.session_start_utc, s.session_end_utc)::INT AS duration_seconds,
    s.event_count::INT AS event_count,
    s.page_view_count::INT AS page_view_count,
    s.landing_page_path::VARCHAR AS landing_page_path,
    s.referrer_host::VARCHAR AS referrer_host,
    (s.page_view_count <= 1 AND s.event_count <= 1)::BOOLEAN AS is_bounce,
    s.has_add_to_cart::BOOLEAN AS has_add_to_cart,
    s.has_order::BOOLEAN AS has_order
  FROM grouped AS s
  WHERE
    s.session_start_utc >= TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-01 00:00:00')
    AND s.session_start_utc < TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-02 00:00:00')
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_wh_loch_dublin__stock_ledger
statements.sql:
WITH movements AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_wh_loch_dublin__stock_movements
),

adjustments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_wh_loch_dublin__adjustments
),

receipts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_wh_loch_dublin__receipts
),

picks AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_wh_loch_dublin__picks
),

ledger_rows AS (
  SELECT
    ('movement' || ':' || r.movement_id)::VARCHAR AS movement_key,
    r.sku,
    r.moved_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS moved_at_utc,
    r.qty_delta::INT AS qty_delta,
    'movement'::VARCHAR AS movement_type
  FROM movements AS r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ('adjustment' || ':' || r.adjustment_id)::VARCHAR AS movement_key,
    r.sku,
    r.adjusted_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS moved_at_utc,
    r.qty_delta::INT AS qty_delta,
    'adjustment'::VARCHAR AS movement_type
  FROM adjustments AS r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ('receipt' || ':' || r.receipt_id)::VARCHAR AS movement_key,
    r.sku,
    r.received_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS moved_at_utc,
    r.quantity::INT AS qty_delta,
    'receipt'::VARCHAR AS movement_type
  FROM receipts AS r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ('pick' || ':' || r.pick_id)::VARCHAR AS movement_key,
    r.sku,
    r.picked_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS moved_at_utc,
    (-r.quantity)::INT AS qty_delta,
    'pick'::VARCHAR AS movement_type
  FROM picks AS r
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    l.movement_key,
    l.sku,
    l.moved_at_utc,
    l.qty_delta,
    l.movement_type,
    SUM(l.qty_delta) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.sku
      ORDER BY l.moved_at_utc, l.movement_key
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )::INT AS on_hand_after,
    (SUM(l.qty_delta) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.sku
      ORDER BY l.moved_at_utc, l.movement_key
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) < 0)::BOOLEAN AS is_negative_stock
  FROM ledger_rows AS l
  WHERE
    l.sku IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_returns_eu_west__reason_classes
statements.sql:
WITH source_rows AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_returns_eu_west__return_requests
),

classified AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(broken|damag|crack|leak).*') THEN 'damaged'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(wrong|incorrect|not what).*') THEN 'wrong_item'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(small|large|size|fit).*') THEN 'size_fit'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(late|delay|never arrived).*') THEN 'late'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(changed my mind|no longer|not needed).*') THEN 'changed_mind'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS reason_class
  FROM source_rows AS s
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.reason_class::VARCHAR AS reason_class,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS row_count,
    ROUND(100 * RATIO_TO_REPORT(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS share_percent
  FROM classified AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.reason_class
)

SELECT *
FROM final

)

),

calendar_rows AS (
  SELECT d.report_date

  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.report_date
  FROM payments_daily AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.report_date
  FROM refunds_daily AS d
),

calendar AS (

final AS (

    c.report_date,

    COALESCE(refunds.refunds_calendar_month, 0)::INT AS refunds_calendar_month
  FROM calendar AS c
  LEFT JOIN sales_daily AS sales
    ON c.report_date = sales.report_date
  LEFT JOIN payments_daily AS payments
    ON c.report_date = payments.report_date
  LEFT JOIN refunds_daily AS refunds
    ON c.report_date = refunds.report_date
)

  FROM rel__int_shop_us__refunds
),

  SELECT

      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(wrong|incorrect|not what).*') THEN 'wrong_item'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(small|large|size|fit).*') THEN 'size_fit'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(late|delay|never arrived).*') THEN 'late'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(s.reason_text), '.*(changed my mind|no longer|not needed).*') THEN 'changed_mind'

    END AS reason_class
  FROM source_rows AS s
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.reason_class::VARCHAR AS reason_class,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS row_count,
    ROUND(100 * RATIO_TO_REPORT(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS share_percent
  FROM classified AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.reason_class
)

SELECT *
FROM final

)

    TRIM(b.order_ref)::VARCHAR AS order_id,
    b.package_count::INT AS package_count,
    b.packed_ts::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS packed_at_local,
    COALESCE(b.extra:dimensions, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT())::OBJECT AS dimensions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.order_ref
      ORDER BY b.packed_ts, b.pack_ref
    )::INT AS order_pack_number,
    b._schema_version AS source_schema_version,
    NULLIF(
  TRIM(STRIP_NULL_VALUE((b._meta:origin.txid))::VARCHAR),
  ''
) AS source_txid,
    COALESCE(b._meta:origin.backfill::BOOLEAN, FALSE) AS is_backfill_row,
    b._seq AS source_seq,
  TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(b._loaded_at) AS source_loaded_at
  FROM base AS b
)

FROM final

  FROM rel__wh_tarn_coventry__slotting
),

  FROM src
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY slot_id, _loaded_at ORDER BY _seq DESC) = 1
),

versions AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    LEAD(s._loaded_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.slot_id ORDER BY s._seq) AS next_loaded_at
  FROM cdc_history AS s
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(h.slot_id), '[^A-Za-z0-9_:.-]', '')::VARCHAR AS slot_id,
    h._seq::NUMBER(38, 0) AS version_seq,
    (h._op = 'D')::BOOLEAN AS is_deleted,
    h._loaded_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS valid_from_loaded_at,
    h.next_loaded_at::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS valid_to_loaded_at,
    (h.next_loaded_at IS NULL)::BOOLEAN AS is_current,
    UPPER(TRIM(h.bin_code))::VARCHAR AS bin_code,
    UPPER(TRIM(h.zone))::VARCHAR AS zone
  FROM versions AS h
)

FROM final
